resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Wikipedia agree on 1952 for the present structure and 1930 for the Aermotor tower it replaced. The NRHP listing's 1925-1949 period and 1932 significant year do not match 1952; the nomination was not readable, so the conflict stays open.

Wikipedia's infobox says Coconino National Forest but its body says Coronado National Forest; the register, NRHP record and TreeAlive all say Coconino, so Coronado is treated as an error in Wikipedia.

notes_for_editor: Status is unconfirmed. The record says standing and the 2014 register visit form says good condition, but Wikipedia's short description says 'Destroyed fire lookout house' with no supporting text. The NRHP listing (Moqui Lookout Cabin, 1988) has a 1925-1949 period and 1932 significant year, which do not match the 1952 tower; the nomination PDF (NARA s3 link returned 403) and the NPGallery GetAsset link could not be read, so it is not known whether the listing covers the 1952 structure or an earlier cabin. The Wikipedia body describes a groundhouse with a 14x14 ft footprint, while the register describes a cab on a metal tower. A surgent.net excerpt about a 1954 inspection was in search results only (the site's certificate had expired) and is not used. Access is unknown; no access key set. Height 83 ft converted to 25.3 m. The 2014 comment about the author's parents is a visitor's personal note, not an official staffing record; the commenter is not named in the story. Story wording was changed from 'stands' to 'is in' and from 'at this site' to 'in the Blue Ridge area' because the link between the 1988 listing and the 1952 tower is unconfirmed.
